target.title: fix(zalo): bound proxy fetcher cache to 64 entries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Zalo `resolveZaloProxyFetch` retained one `makeProxyFetch` entry per distinct proxy URL in a process-lifetime `Map` with no eviction. Config churn or high-cardinality proxy URLs could therefore grow gateway memory without a hard bound.

## Why This Change Was Made

- Cap `proxyCache` at 64 entries using the shared `pruneMapToMaxSize` helper after every successful insert (same pattern as Nextcloud Talk room cache / MS Teams team-group cache / Mattermost opaque-target cache).
- Insertion-order eviction keeps newest proxy fetchers; cache-hit identity and empty-URL behavior are unchanged.
- Adds a focused regression that fills `max+1` distinct URLs, proves the oldest entry is rebuilt on next use, and confirms a mid-window entry still hits.

No new config/env surface. Does not change Bot API timeouts (`#104017`) or other Zalo send paths.

## User Impact

**Before:** Long-running Zalo gateways could retain an unbounded number of proxy fetcher closures as distinct proxy URLs appeared.

**After:** At most 64 distinct proxy fetchers are retained; older ones are dropped and rebuilt on next use.

## Evidence

Head: `3f52179ed7cbf662dedcc42a2a3b949752db5d57`

Executable negative control + fix proof:

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/zalo/src/proxy.test.ts -- --run --reporter=verbose
```

```text
stdout | extensions/zalo/src/proxy.test.ts > resolveZaloProxyFetch > negative control: Map without prune retains oldest after 65 inserts
[zalo proxyCache negative control] unbounded_size=65 unbounded_keeps_oldest=true bounded_size=64 bounded_evicts_oldest=true
[zalo proxyCache proof] max=64 filled=65 oldest_evicted=true rebuilt=true mid_hit=true
 ✓ |extension-zalo| extensions/zalo/src/proxy.test.ts > resolveZaloProxyFetch > negative control: Map without prune retains oldest after 65 inserts 3ms
 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  5 passed (5)
```

- **Negative control (executable):** same 65-URL insert sequence on a plain `Map` **without** `pruneMapToMaxSize` keeps size 65 and retains the oldest URL.
- **After fix:** same sequence with `pruneMapToMaxSize(..., 64)` evicts oldest; `resolveZaloProxyFetch` rebuilds proxy-0 after fill while a mid-window URL still hits.
- Touched: `extensions/zalo/src/proxy.ts` (+ colocated test). Sibling Nextcloud/MS Teams/Mattermost prune callers unchanged.

AI-assisted.
